advisory_mechanism: blame revision/option guard omits --contents/-S and returns an arbitrary local file through blame output
vulnerable_source: caller-controlled blame revision and kwargs containing --contents/-S, including positional/cluster forms
vulnerable_sink: Repo.blame -> git blame --contents/-S reads and returns the named local file
security_invariant: blame/revision unsafe-option validation must cover file-read options and positional option clusters

advisory_mechanism: an unrelated config write reserializes an inert resident multiline value into a live Git config directive
vulnerable_source: pre-existing multiline config value accepted during read and retained in memory
vulnerable_sink: GitConfigParser write-back serialization during a later unrelated config mutation
security_invariant: resident multiline values must remain quoted/escaped so write-back cannot create directives

advisory_mechanism: Diffable.diff forwards caller option kwargs including --output without the unsafe-option gate
vulnerable_source: caller-controlled Diffable.diff option kwargs selecting output/output=<path>
vulnerable_sink: git diff --output writes to the attacker-selected filesystem path
security_invariant: unsafe diff file-write options must be denied unless allow_unsafe_options is explicit

advisory_mechanism: Repo.init permits caller-controlled --template and Git copies executable hooks into the initialized repository
vulnerable_source: Repo.init template/--template caller argument
vulnerable_sink: git init --template copies attacker-controlled executable hook files into the new repository
security_invariant: Repo.init must gate --template as unsafe before invoking git init

advisory_mechanism: IndexFile.remove and Head.checkout omit the pathspec-from-file unsafe-option gate
vulnerable_source: caller kwargs --pathspec-from-file / --pathspec-file-nul at remove and checkout APIs
vulnerable_sink: git rm/checkout reads pathspecs from the named local file and applies them to repository paths
security_invariant: both APIs must check unsafe_git_pathspec_from_file_options before invoking Git

advisory_mechanism: read-tree callers accept --index-output without an unsafe-option gate
vulnerable_source: caller-controlled read-tree positional/keyword option --index-output=<path>
vulnerable_sink: git read-tree --index-output overwrites the attacker-selected file
security_invariant: read-tree call sites must deny index-output unless unsafe options are explicitly allowed

advisory_mechanism: caller-controlled section or option names containing newlines inject additional Git config directives
vulnerable_source: section and option names supplied to config writer APIs
vulnerable_sink: GitConfigParser section/option header and assignment serialization
security_invariant: section and option names must reject newline/directive syntax before serialization

advisory_mechanism: clone denylist omits --separate-git-dir and permits attacker-selected repository metadata placement
vulnerable_source: Repo.clone_from / clone kwargs selecting separate_git_dir
vulnerable_sink: git clone --separate-git-dir writes repository metadata at the attacker-selected path
security_invariant: clone must gate --separate-git-dir as an unsafe metadata-placement option

advisory_mechanism: TagReference.create positional ref bypasses the kwargs-only --file/-F guard
vulnerable_source: caller-controlled positional ref encoding --file/-F and a local path
vulnerable_sink: git tag reads the named local file as tag message content
security_invariant: TagReference.create must gate file-read options in both kwargs and positional/cluster forms

advisory_mechanism: strict browser SSRF policy accepts hostname navigation even though Chromium resolves it independently of Node pinning
vulnerable_source: browser navigation URL with a hostname under strict SSRF policy
vulnerable_sink: Chromium navigation / remote CDP Browserbase path resolves and connects to the hostname, permitting a rebinding hop to private space
security_invariant: strict navigation must use an IP literal or explicit hostname allowlist; CDP HTTP discovery must use pinned guarded fetch

advisory_mechanism: native prompt/history image auto-load reads out-of-workspace local paths despite tools.fs.workspaceOnly
vulnerable_source: local path, file URL, or sandbox-mounted path detected in prompt/history image references
vulnerable_sink: detectAndLoadPromptImages -> loadImageFromRef -> loadWebMedia reads bytes and injects them as vision input
security_invariant: workspaceOnly must be enforced before native prompt/history image filesystem reads

advisory_mechanism: small compressed images declare oversized dimensions and reach metadata/decode/resize backends before a pixel cap
vulnerable_source: untrusted image bytes with huge or overflowed width and height headers
vulnerable_sink: Sharp or macOS sips metadata, orientation, decode, conversion, and resize operations
security_invariant: pixel count and dimension validity must be checked before any image backend work

advisory_mechanism: unauthenticated Synology webhook token guesses are not throttled before token validation
vulnerable_source: repeated webhook POST payload tokens from a remote IP
vulnerable_sink: authorizeSynologyWebhook validateToken comparison before authenticated per-user limiter
security_invariant: invalid-token attempts must have a separate pre-authentication remote-IP budget

advisory_mechanism: Python sandbox permits object-graph and frame/builtin introspection paths to escape restricted execution
vulnerable_source: caller-controlled Python source passed to python_tools sandbox.run / execution helpers
vulnerable_sink: python_tools.py AST validation and generated/direct execution paths; print.__self__, frame/code attributes, and attribute-form blocked calls expose host execution capabilities
security_invariant: untrusted Python must not reach imports, real builtins, frame/code objects, filesystem, or process execution through any AST/object-graph spelling

advisory_mechanism: URL mentions and spider validation accept alternate loopback encodings and internal destinations
vulnerable_source: caller-controlled @url mention or SpiderTools URL, including localhost-dot, short/octal/hex/integer IPv4 forms
vulnerable_sink: MentionsParser._process_url_mention urllib.request fetch and SpiderTools network fetch after _validate_url
security_invariant: every fetched URL host must be canonicalized and rejected when loopback, private, reserved, link-local, metadata, or internal

advisory_mechanism: array * integer allocates intModifier * array.Count output without LoopLimit accounting
vulnerable_source: script array multiplied by attacker-controlled integer
vulnerable_sink: ScriptArray.cs multiplication preallocates and materializes repeated array elements
security_invariant: all array multiplication output cardinality must be checked and charged to LoopLimit before allocation/emission

advisory_mechanism: array multiplication still bypasses LoopLimit when the repeated lazy ScriptRange emits no items
vulnerable_source: lazy ScriptRange input plus attacker-controlled outer repetition count
vulnerable_sink: the same array multiplication dispatch repeats a lazy range while outer repetition is uncharged
security_invariant: all array multiplication output work, including empty/lazy iterations, must be checked and charged to LoopLimit

advisory_mechanism: GroupView role pill, dropdown, and option-label HTML construction accepts stored role labels at an HTML sink
vulnerable_source: stored OptionName role labels serialized from GroupView.php into GroupView.js
vulnerable_sink: GroupView.js role-pill, dropdown, and option-label HTML-string concatenations
security_invariant: stored role labels must be HTML-escaped at every generated-markup text boundary

advisory_mechanism: Group member phone, email, and name are escaped for HTML text but interpolated into URL and quoted-attribute contexts
vulnerable_source: stored member phone, email, and name values after escapeHtml
vulnerable_sink: GroupView.js tel: href, mailto: href, and quoted data-name attributes
security_invariant: URL and quoted HTML attributes require attribute-context escaping; HTML text escaping is insufficient

advisory_mechanism: renderPersonActionMenu uses HTML-text escaping for a quoted data-person_name attribute
vulnerable_source: stored person name passed to renderPersonActionMenu and escapeHtml
vulnerable_sink: CRMJSOM.js quoted data-person_name attribute
security_invariant: person names placed in quoted attributes must use escapeAttribute, not escapeHtml

advisory_mechanism: FundRaiserDelete performs a destructive delete from a GET parameter without a CSRF check
vulnerable_source: attacker-induced GET request carrying $_GET[FundRaiserID]
vulnerable_sink: FundRaiserDelete.php fundraiser deletion after only a role check
security_invariant: destructive state change must require POST plus CSRFMiddleware validation

advisory_mechanism: workspace .env HOMEBREW_BREW_FILE selects an unintended Homebrew-compatible executable in skill-install flows
vulnerable_source: workspace dotenv HOMEBREW_BREW_FILE (and ambient HOMEBREW_PREFIX path influence)
vulnerable_sink: src/infra/brew.ts Homebrew executable/path resolution used by skill installation
security_invariant: workspace-controlled environment values must not select the package-manager executable

advisory_mechanism: workspace .env CLOUDSDK_PYTHON selects the interpreter used by Gmail setup gcloud execution
vulnerable_source: workspace dotenv CLOUDSDK_PYTHON
vulnerable_sink: Gmail setup gcloudEnv() and gcloud child-process interpreter selection
security_invariant: workspace-controlled environment values must not select the interpreter used by gcloud

advisory_mechanism: ${file:...} references in TypeScript, C#, and Rust runtimes read absolute, traversal, or symlink-escaped paths without an allowed-root boundary
vulnerable_source: untrusted .prompty frontmatter string ${file:absolute-or-relative-path}
vulnerable_sink: runtime loaders resolve then read the referenced host file (readFileSync/File IO/std::fs)
security_invariant: canonical target must remain inside the prompt directory or an explicit host-provided allowed root

advisory_mechanism: token-authenticated no-device lower-privilege WebSocket clients receive admin-sensitive hello-ok snapshot fields
vulnerable_source: token-authenticated WebSocket connect with device=null and non-admin scopes
vulnerable_sink: buildGatewaySnapshot hello-ok exposes configPath, stateDir, and authMode
security_invariant: sensitive snapshot metadata must be included only when effective scopes contain operator.admin

advisory_mechanism: unrestricted Nunjucks rendering permits prototype/constructor traversal and calls on host input objects
vulnerable_source: attacker-controlled Nunjucks template plus host-supplied input objects/functions
vulnerable_sink: Nunjucks Environment.renderString memberLookup and callWrap reach inherited properties and callable host values
security_invariant: templates may read only sanitized own data and may not traverse __proto__/constructor/prototype or call functions

advisory_mechanism: TypeScript loader invokes gray-matter with executable js/javascript frontmatter engines enabled
vulnerable_source: untrusted .prompty document beginning with ---js or ---javascript frontmatter
vulnerable_sink: gray-matter parser evaluates the JavaScript frontmatter body in the host process
security_invariant: frontmatter parsing must reject executable engines before evaluation

advisory_mechanism: allowInsecureAuth lets token/password Control UI sessions bypass secure-context and paired-device requirements
vulnerable_source: Control UI WebSocket connect over insecure context with allowInsecureAuth=true and missing device identity
vulnerable_sink: gateway message-handler allowControlUiBypass authorizes the no-device handshake
security_invariant: allowInsecureAuth must not bypass secure context or device authentication; only explicit dangerouslyDisableDeviceAuth may do so

advisory_mechanism: trusted CDP /json/version response supplies an untrusted webSocketDebuggerUrl second-hop target
vulnerable_source: webSocketDebuggerUrl parsed from remote /json/version JSON response
vulnerable_sink: createTargetViaCdp / Chrome version discovery opens the returned WebSocket URL
security_invariant: every discovered WebSocket endpoint must be revalidated against SSRF policy before connection

release_boundary.shared_candidate_correction: 75602014 adds direct ws/wss and skips /json/version; public mechanism predates it

advisory_mechanism: named Synology accounts inherit the same webhook path and replaceExisting registration collapses route ownership and policy context
vulnerable_source: multi-account Synology configuration with inherited or duplicate webhookPath values
vulnerable_sink: registerPluginHttpRoute path registration with replaceExisting transfers a shared route between account handlers
security_invariant: enabled accounts must use explicit unique webhook paths and route registration must fail closed on collisions
